_comment: Mechanical architecture gate for TrackPoli: Next.js (App Router) + Supabase (facts, workflow, auth) + Sanity (editorial prose). Encodes the layering UI -> data hooks -> services/domain -> lib/integrations, exactly one client per backend, edge functions composing a shared layer, and the Supabase/Sanity data-ownership boundary from decisions.md. Rule names are stable ids: a waiver's 'rule' must match one exactly. Greenfield repo, so these are clean-invariant rules enforced blocking from the first commit; no baseline waivers.
_ignore_note: The vendored engine (.claude, always-on) is the upstream standard, governed by its own CI, not TrackPoli's gate; this gate scans TrackPoli's own code (src, supabase/functions, sanity). discriminate-fixtures/vendor/worktrees are intentionally-bad or generated trees.
_builtins_note: ON because TrackPoli is new: emptyCatch/swallowReturn catch a catch that neither recovers, retries nor reports; keepInSync catches the duplicated-fact 'kept in sync' smell, which is the Supabase/Sanity mirror risk.

rules.name: UI must not access a backend directly
rules.message: Data access inside a component/page/route. Route reads through the hook/service that OWNS this data so there is one read path, and route writes through the admin service; a schema/RLS/Sanity change then touches one file, not dozens.

rules.name: Services and domain must not import UI or touch web globals
rules.message: Service/domain code leaks a web/HTTP/UI concern and can no longer be tested or reused without a request or a browser. The request stops at the route boundary and becomes plain data before it reaches a service.

rules.name: Exactly one Supabase client
rules.message: A second Supabase client. There is exactly one configured client per context (browser/server/admin) in src/lib/supabase. Import the canonical client; never construct another (auth/session/RLS config must live in one place).

rules.name: Exactly one Sanity client
rules.message: A second Sanity client. There is one configured Sanity client in src/lib/sanity. Import it; never construct another.

rules.name: Sanity owns prose, not facts (no factual fields in Sanity schemas)
rules.message: A factual field is being defined in a Sanity schema. Facts are owned by Supabase (decisions.md: one owner per fact). Sanity documents reference a Supabase record id and hold prose only; they never duplicate a factual field.

rules.name: Edge functions must not hand-roll auth or read service-role secrets in the handler
rules.message: Auth/admin logic hand-rolled per function drifts and cannot be hardened in one place. Use the shared request-auth + admin-client helpers in supabase/functions/_shared.

rules.name: Edge functions must not hand-roll CORS or responses in the handler
rules.message: Inline CORS/response shaping duplicated per function drifts (a missing preflight header silently fails requests). Use the shared cors/json helpers in supabase/functions/_shared.
